coordinate_system: Y-up, character forward is +Z, character right is +X

character.proportions: neutral adult-proportioned anatomical reference; do not infer exact body measurements from poster
character.mesh: single watertight skinned character mesh where practical

materials.muscle_highlights: red translucent overlay, separate mesh/material layer

rig.deform_quality: clean joint deformation at shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees

exercise.name: Pull-Up
exercise.equipment: properly installed, load-rated pull-up bar; supervised setup where appropriate
exercise.setup: Hang from a secure pull-up bar with an overhand grip around shoulder width; feet clear of the floor; begin from a controlled active hang.

keyframes.label: active_hang
keyframes.pose: arms extended comfortably; shoulders controlled rather than shrugged; legs quiet; no swinging.

keyframes.label: pulling
keyframes.pose: draw shoulder blades down and back; bend elbows and bring torso upward smoothly; avoid kicking.

keyframes.label: top_controlled
keyframes.pose: reach the highest controlled position available without craning the neck; chin may approach bar level.

keyframes.label: lowering
keyframes.pose: lower smoothly under control; avoid dropping suddenly; keep legs quiet.

keyframes.label: return_hang
keyframes.pose: return to controlled hang; pause before next repetition.

exercise.safety_note: Only animate or perform this with a professionally installed, load-rated bar. Do not use doorframes, loose furniture, or improvised supports. A supported row or band-assisted version is a safer alternative when equipment or strength is uncertain.
